draft.emotion: bright and welcoming, flicking a switch as you walk into a room
notes: Singular only. Takes the ending -у in the prepositional case after в and на in the literal sense: стоять на свету (to stand in the light).
In everyday speech, свет also means home electricity: включить/выключить свет (to turn the light on/off), отключили свет (the power went out).
